name: Medical store
intro: A medical store may give medicines on credit to regular customers, and buy stock from distributors on credit. BolCash helps you keep both records in one place.

uses.title: Customer udhar
uses.body: Note down medicines given on credit and the payments you receive.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your distributors, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
